name: Selvrek Sorrel-Grapefruit Burn
manufacturer: Selvrek Craft (street brand, the Gray Zone-adjacent)
description: A sharp, aggressively sour soda blending synth-sorrel with real grapefruit rind extract. Selvrek operates out of licensed micro-breweries in the corponation quarter and lower Tier 2 zones, selling direct to corner stores and market stalls.
flavor_profile: Immediate sour-bitter punch of grapefruit pith, then a dark floral sorrel wave, finishing with a persistent tart burn at the back of the palate
cultural_context: Selvrek has underground credibility in the Gray Zone food scene. It's too sour for casual drinkers, which is exactly why its regulars love it. Sharing a Selvrek is a mild social ritual among the Gray Zone youth — a small test of toughness that everyone pretends isn't one.
story_hooks: Selvrek's micro-brewery license is up for renewal and a corponation rep has been offering the founder an acquisition deal that would move production to a sanitized Tier 3 facility — the neighborhood is divided on whether to let it happen
A Selvrek bottle was found at a crime scene in the Gray Zone with a coded message etched into the interior of the cap — someone has been using the distribution network to pass information

An underground mixologist has built a cult following around a cocktail called the Selvrek Circuit, combining the soda with a restricted synthetic stimulant — the drink is technically legal, the stimulant isn't
